news.headline: Mandatory Biometric Aadhaar Authentication for Subsidised Domestic LPG Refills
news.story_lead: The Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas has made Biometric Aadhaar Authentication (BAA) mandatory for domestic LPG consumers to book cylinder refills at subsidized rates.
bullet_points: Effective from October 1, 2026 across all domestic LPG distributors.
Over 89.9% (27.43 Crore) active domestic consumers have already completed verification.
Aims to prevent commercial diversion of subsidized domestic LPG cylinders.
news.exam_relevance: Relevant for UPSC GS Paper II (Governance & Scheme Implementation) and Banking/SSC exams.
news.takeaway: Mandatory BAA ensures targeted financial subsidy delivery and prevents diversion.

news.headline: Semicon 2.0 Roadmap Launched with ₹1 Lakh Crore Investment Commitments
news.story_lead: The Ministry of Electronics and IT unveiled the execution framework for Semicon 2.0 during SEMICON India 2026 at Yashobhoomi, New Delhi.
bullet_points: Attracted over ₹1 Lakh Crore in private investment commitments across 16 MoUs.
Focuses on 6 pillars: chip design, fab capacity, packaging, research, equipment, and talent.
Targeting support for 200 semiconductor design start-ups across Indian universities.
news.exam_relevance: Relevant for UPSC GS Paper III (Technology & Industrial Policy) and State PCS.
news.takeaway: Semicon 2.0 expands India's semiconductor ecosystem beyond assembly to full-stack manufacturing.

news.headline: Smriti Mandhana Scripts History as Highest Run-Scorer in Women's T20Is
news.story_lead: Indian women's cricket team vice-captain Smriti Mandhana became the highest run-scorer in Women's T20 International history during the Asian Games 2026.
bullet_points: Reached a milestone total of 4,788 T20I runs.
Achieved during the Asian Games 2026 semi-final match against Bangladesh.
India also secured two silver medals in shooting at the Games.
news.exam_relevance: Relevant for SSC, Banking, Railway, and State PCS sports current affairs questions.
news.takeaway: Mandhana now holds the world record for the highest overall aggregate runs in Women's T20Is.
